provenance.notes: API page read 2026-11-10: CO-OPS throttles 'the quantity / volume of data queries received from a singular customer' and recommends 'sleep statements' between successive calls, without a figure; download only the data needed. Per-request length limits: 1-minute data 4 days, 6-minute data 1 month, hourly and high/low 1 year, daily 10 years, monthly 200 years, currents 1 month (all bins 7 days), high/low predictions 10 years, max/slack predictions 1 year. The 'application' parameter is optional but asked for (company, organisation or application name) to identify callers in logs. Disclaimers page: information in the public domain unless annotated otherwise; NOS 'requests that attribution be given' (a request); must not be modified and presented as official; raw/preliminary data used only with caution. Covers both https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/prod/datagetter and .../mdapi/prod/webapi/.
